label: r0
issues: Silhouette reads as a lumpy blob, not a sitting fox, at a glance
Head is not distinct from body - no snout, muzzle or tapered face
Ears are oversized angled slabs tilted outward rather than upright pointed triangles
Eyes are two black round plates stuck on the side, misaligned and too low
White chest/bib is a small offset block on one side instead of a centered front blaze
Tail is a tiny white/orange stub hanging off the back rather than a large curled tail with white tip
No front legs or black paws visible from the front; only a couple of dark plates at the base
Exposed studs and gaps everywhere; surfaces unfinished, not official-set quality
Overall proportions too tall and narrow compared to the broad seated concept
distilled: A LEGO model of a chunky sitting fox built from stacked bricks and plates, with a rounded curved-slope body, pointed side-stud ears, and a short thick tail.
